summary: REQ-4 appears implemented: the WhatsApp CTA is now a real <a> element with href set to the existing deep links for Bike Tyres and Car Tyres, wrapping the Button so clicks should navigate reliably (opens in new tab via target="_blank"). No evidence of edits under frontend/src/components/ui, and the page remains a single-page landing page.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/modified footer attribution link to caffeine.ai with UTM parameters derived from hostname (appIdentifier).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request adding or changing footer attribution/marketing links; it also explicitly lists analytics/tracking as non-goals, and UTM parameters can be considered tracking-related.
